STATUS: Pilot C forward-collection health. MEASUREMENT ONLY — no edge claim. No edge conclusion may be drawn from unsettled fixtures.

discovery_health.note: Discovery ran and found upcoming covered fixtures. Inflow is live.

collection_health.ratio_note: Ratio materially below 1.0 means we are NOT capturing available covered fixtures — investigate scheduling/coverage. Should be visible by week three, not at the readout date.

timeline.settle_rate_note: Weeks-to-readout from the SETTLE rate is a noisy extrapolation until many fixtures have settled; treat it as indicative only while total_settled is small.
timeline.inflow_note: Inflow is the binding constraint early on. The ~38.5-week projection assumes ~10 covered fixtures/week. If observed inflow is materially below that, the timeline slips — surfaced here, not at the readout date.
timeline.slippage_note: If weeks-to-readout at the observed rate exceeds the original ~38.5-week projection, collection is running slower than planned.

ratio_recovery.all_time_ratio_note: Dragged down by the unscheduled-gap backlog and the 22 permanently-missed windows (sunk, never backdated). NOT the steady-state measure.
ratio_recovery.first_week_ratio_note: This is the real measure of steady-state capture once discovery+scheduler are live. Should recover toward 1.0; the 0.18 baseline reflects the unscheduled gap, not steady-state performance.
